lines.text: A Levite from Ephraim's hill country takes a Bethlehem concubine, and after she leaves, he goes to bring her back.
The girl's father persuades the Levite to stay three days, and then keeps urging him to stay longer.
The Levite refuses to stop at Jericho because it is a city of foreigners, so he goes on.
No one in Gibeah takes them in until an old man from Ephraim brings the Levite to his house.
The Levite puts his unresponsive concubine on his donkey, goes home, and cuts her into seven pieces.
